Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.

changedPrimitive: Coefficient quantization only: safe AVX-512F/AVX2 lanes retain original binary64 division by each exact integer quantizer, floor the quotient magnitude, increment on an exact fraction of at least one half, restore its sign and convert to bounded Int32. Every finite encoder quotient and away-from-zero half tie remains exact. The existing 256-byte coefficient destination uses a safe stack span inside the already admitted fixed 8192-byte workspace. Original transform, color/alpha, quality, sampling/entropy order, encoded bytes and work/admission/cancellation remain unchanged. Scalar fallback retained. No reciprocal approximation, new table, buffer, cache or dependency; direct allocation controls show no added heap bytes.
algorithmSpecification: T.81 F.1.1.4 and A.3.4; original owned binary64/away-from-zero policy retained.

allocationChange.explanation: The initial helper call prevented JIT stack promotion of the existing int[64]. Encode JIT listings show one added 64-element Int32 heap array (24-byte x64 array header plus 256 payload bytes). Explicit safe stack storage restores identical direct allocation totals; initial screens and failed strict allocation control are retained.

uncertainty: Two independent three-sample screens guide rank, not uniform-parity certification. Conservative upper divides managed 99.9% Student-t upper mean by the smaller native bracket lower mean with the same critical value. Keep post-run quietness failures and later passing cooldowns.
